privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Jawab24 - Smart Auto-Reply for Facebook & Instagram Pages
privacy.introText: Jawab24 ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our Facebook auto-reply service at jawab24.com.
privacy.collectText: When you use Jawab24, we collect:
privacy.collectItem1: Facebook Account Information: Your name, email, and profile picture when you log in with Facebook.
privacy.collectItem2: Facebook Page Data: Information about Pages you manage, including page name, ID, and access tokens.
privacy.collectItem3: Comments and Messages: Content of comments and messages on your connected Pages to provide auto-reply functionality.
privacy.collectItem4: Business Information: Any business details you provide to customize AI-generated replies.
privacy.useItem1: Provide and maintain our auto-reply service
privacy.useItem2: Generate intelligent responses to comments and messages
privacy.useItem4: Communicate with you about service updates
privacy.shareText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
privacy.shareItem1: OpenAI: Comment/message content is sent to OpenAI to generate replies. This data is processed according to OpenAI's privacy policy.
privacy.shareItem2: Facebook: We interact with Facebook's API to read and respond to comments/messages on your behalf.
privacy.shareItem3: Service Providers: We use cloud hosting providers to operate our service.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, secure servers, and access controls to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.retentionText: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.rightsItem5: Revoke Facebook permissions at any time
privacy.deletionText: To delete your data, you can either:
privacy.deletionItem1: Log into Jawab24 and delete your account from settings
privacy.deletionItem2: Remove the Jawab24 app from your Facebook settings
privacy.deletionItem3: Contact us at the email below
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
privacy.corporateAddress: Registered Address: Bergavägen 15 A lgh 1002, 241 39 Eslöv, Sweden

terms.descText: Jawab24 provides automated reply services for Facebook Pages. The Service uses artificial intelligence to generate and post responses to comments and messages on your connected Facebook Pages.

terms.requireItem4: Maintain the security of your account
terms.useText: You agree not to use the Service to:
terms.useItem1: Violate Facebook's Terms of Service or Community Standards
terms.useItem2: Send spam, misleading, or harmful content
terms.useItem4: Impersonate others or misrepresent your affiliation
terms.aiText: You acknowledge that responses generated by our AI service may not always be perfect or appropriate. You are responsible for:
terms.aiItem1: Reviewing the business information you provide
terms.aiItem2: Monitoring the replies sent on your behalf
terms.aiItem3: Disabling auto-reply if responses are inappropriate
terms.availText: We strive to maintain high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. The Service may be temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, updates, or factors beyond our control.
terms.liabilityText: Jawab24 is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from:
terms.liabilityItem1: Use or inability to use the Service
terms.liabilityItem2: AI-generated content posted to your Pages
terms.liabilityItem4: Actions taken by Facebook regarding your account or Pages
terms.termText: We may suspend or terminate your access to the Service at any time for violation of these terms. You may disconnect your Pages and stop using the Service at any time.
terms.changesText: We may modify these Terms at any time. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
